main.description: Accounts owning public repositories an appview has indexed, whose handle holds the query, ignoring case: those it starts with first, then by their newest repository. Gists are not counted, and an account owning only gists is not found. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

ownerView.description: An account, with how many public repositories it owns.

repoCount.description: How many public repositories the account owns, as the appview has indexed them.

description: Accounts owning public repositories an appview has indexed, found by handle.
